notes: Permission errors no longer masquerade as an expired session: an ownership failure returned 401, which made the web app clear the token and hard-redirect to login, discarding whatever was open — including a prescription mid-save. It now returns 403 and the page stays put. Errors whose message merely contained the word "Invalid" were logging users out for the same reason; that rule is gone. Uploads cut off by a client disconnect are recorded as one warning line instead of a server error stack trace. Socket.io and notifications are now off by default (ENABLE_SOCKET=1 / ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS=1 to restore), which stops the connect/disconnect churn in the server window and keeps the notifications table from growing.
